title: Position: Fairness Failure in Generative Models is an Evaluation Problem

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name and gender term substitutions in text prompts to evaluate role assignment (e.g., manager vs. assistant) and stereotype keyword rates, as well as qualitative visual inspection of image generations for occupational prompts to identify gender skew.

Counterfactual substitution of religious identities (Muslim vs. Christian) in prompts to measure differences in generated stereotype keywords, demeaning language, and refusal/deflection rates across demographic slices.
Qualitative visual inspection of generated images for occupational text-to-image prompts (e.g., 'A portrait of a CEO') to identify skews in skin tone representation and racial defaults.
